entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a VeloBand Cadence Sensor I just bought.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the sensor? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a technical fault. The cadence numbers are nonsense. It's basically garbage.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I understand you're frustrated. Sometimes a quick recalibration can fix that. If you have a moment, I can walk you through the steps...
Look, I really don't have time for all that. I'm not interested in troubleshooting. I just want my money back. Can you process the refund or not?
I understand completely. No problem. Let me just pull up your order information... one moment.
Okay, I see the order here. It was delivered five days ago. According to our policy, you're well within the 90-day return window.
Good. So what do I do?

I've just approved the return for you. I am emailing a prepaid shipping label to the address we have on file. Simply pack the item in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, we'll issue the full refund.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
